name: PubMedQA
intro: PubMedQA是一个基于PubMed摘要的生物医学问答数据集，任务是用“是”、“否”或“可能”回答研究问题。包含1000个专家标注、61200个未标注及211300个人工生成问答，是首个需对生物医学研究文本进行推理的数据集。
org: University of Pittsburgh, Carnegie Mellon University
build_method: PubMed摘要筛选, 医学专家标注, 规则与启发式生成
scale: 1K专家标注 + 61.2K未标注 + 211.3K启发式生成
build_method_en: PubMed abstract filtering, medical-expert annotation, rule-based and heuristic generation
intro_en: PubMedQA is a biomedical question answering dataset based on PubMed abstracts, where the task is to answer research questions with "yes," "no," or "maybe." It includes 1,000 expert-annotated, 61,200 unlabeled, and 211,300 artificially generated QA pairs, making it the first dataset requiring reasoning over biomedical research texts.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1909.06146 Section 3. PQA-L and PQA-U start from PubMed question-title articles with structured conclusions, forming title questions, conclusion-free contexts, and conclusion long answers. Two M.D. candidates label 1,000 PQA-L items with yes/no/maybe and resolve disagreements; 500 support 10-fold cross-validation and 500 are held-out test. Rules retain 61.2K answerable PQA-U items. Separately, statement titles are converted and labeled by negation to produce 211.3K PQA-A items. PQA-L reasoning-required evaluation uses question plus context and reports accuracy and macro-F1.
